_help: Each account becomes a bubble. status: planned | connected | partial | unsupported. 'match' is the text searched for in `claude mcp list` to auto-detect a connector. read_tools are allowed during normal chat; write_tools are only allowed for an action you approve. 'url' is the web page the bubble opens. Tool names must match what `claude mcp list` shows on your device (mcp__<server>__<tool>, or mcp__<server> for all of its tools).

accounts.name: Gmail
accounts.how: Claude connector: Settings > Connectors > Gmail (or claude.ai Gmail in Claude Code).

accounts.name: YouTube
accounts.how: YouTube Data API v3 through a YouTube MCP server, using your own Google Cloud OAuth client.

accounts.name: Google Classroom / e-learning
accounts.how: Google Classroom API through an MCP server; other learning sites only if they publish an API.

accounts.name: TikTok
accounts.how: TikTok Display API only: your profile and your own videos. Requires registering a TikTok developer app.

accounts.name: Google Play Store
accounts.how: No API for a person's own purchases or library. The Play Developer API is only for app publishers. Unofficial scrapers break Google's terms and risk your account.

accounts.name: PlayStation Store
accounts.how: Sony has no public API. Unofficial PSN libraries break Sony's terms and risk a ban.

accounts.name: Servers (afa?)
accounts.how: Waiting on what 'afa servers' means. Servers are usually watched through SSH health checks or a monitoring API.
